SwitchPreference.app:title: Lock launcher UI
SwitchPreference.app:summary: When locked, workspace layout and editing settings cannot be changed

SwitchPreference.app:title: Enable flexible workspace
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Use resizable launcher panes instead of one fixed full-screen content area

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Two-pane first pane size (%)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Used only by the existing two-pane layout; its saved value is preserved when switching to four panes

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Four-pane left column size (%)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Used only by Four panes / quadrants; drag either vertical divider on the launcher to adjust both rows

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Four-pane top row size (%)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Used only by Four panes / quadrants; drag the horizontal divider to resize top and bottom rows

SwitchPreference.app:title: Resizable divider
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Two-pane: resize one divider. Four-pane: resize synchronized columns plus the row divider. Limits remain 15% to 85%.

SwitchPreference.app:title: Long-press empty space to add widgets
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Long-press empty workspace to add an Android widget through the Smart S freeform host

SwitchPreference.app:title: KISS gestures on empty panes
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Keep configured KISS swipe gestures active on empty workspace surfaces

SwitchPreference.app:title: Freeform widget editing
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Long-press a widget for eight resize handles on every side and corner, plus free movement

Preference.app:title: Four-pane behavior
Preference.app:summary: Four-pane mode creates a true 2 × 2 workspace. Existing apps/history and widgets remain authoritative live panes; the two additional quadrants are independent empty workspace surfaces with KISS gestures. Switching back restores the saved two-pane layout.

Preference.app:title: Freeform widget behavior
Preference.app:summary: Workspace widgets use a separate Smart S host: resize from left, right, top, bottom or any corner; move widgets freely; handles disappear outside edit mode. Legacy KISS widget sizing remains only for legacy mode.

Preference.app:title: Pane architecture
Preference.app:summary: Apps & history and Android widgets keep their existing live containers. Four-pane mode extends the geometry without replacing or duplicating those authoritative views.
